submit.title: Submit a Plugin
submit.description: This wizard helps you open a pull request to the plugin catalogue to get your plugin listed.

guidelines.hint: The catalogue has a few requirements for new plugins. Please read the guidelines before continuing.
guidelines.ack: I have read the contributing guidelines and confirm that my plugin meets them

submit.disabled: Plugin submission is not enabled on this deployment.
submit.rate_limited: GitHub limits anonymous requests to 60 per hour per address, and this one is used up. Wait a bit, or try again from another network.

repo.manual_notice: The repository could not be read, so nothing was checked and no plugin list is available. Fill the fields in by hand.
repo.branch_hint: The branch the plugin lives on; check it, since the repository could not be read
repo.select_hint: Paste a github.com repository url, or type owner/repository
repo.invalid: Enter owner/repository, or paste a github.com repository url.
repo.login_hint: The fork is created under this account; it defaults to the plugin repository owner.
repo.related_path_hint: The directory that contains mcdreforged.plugin.json, `.` for the repository root
repo.no_candidates: No mcdreforged.plugin.json was found in this branch. Check the branch, or type the path manually.
repo.candidates_truncated: This repository declares more plugins than can be listed here. Type the plugin directory manually if yours is missing.
repo.tree_truncated: This repository is very large, so the file listing may be incomplete.

details.plugin_id_hint_manual: Nothing could be read from mcdreforged.plugin.json, so enter the id exactly as that file declares it.
details.plugin_id_hint: To change it, edit the id field in mcdreforged.plugin.json in your repository.
details.plugin_id_not_found: No mcdreforged.plugin.json was found at this path
details.introduction_hint: Pick an introduction file for each language you support; at least one language is required. Paths are relative to the plugin directory.

review.skipped_report: No report: the checks were skipped.
review.skipped: GitHub's anonymous request limit is used up, so the checks could not run. You can still submit: the catalogue runs its own checks on the pull request.
review.unavailable: Nothing to show yet, please fix the problems above.
review.preview: The file that will be added to the plugin catalogue

submit.title: Submit to the catalogue
submit.fork_exists: You already have {repo}, so you can skip this step.
submit.fork_conflict: You have a repository named {repo}, but it is not a fork of the catalogue. GitHub would create the fork under a different name, so rename or delete it first if you can.
submit.file_hint: The path and the content are filled in for you. When you commit, pick "Create a new branch for this commit and start a pull request" and GitHub opens the pull request.
submit.direct_hint: You own {repo}, so the file is created there directly and no fork is needed.
submit.order_hint: Do step 1 first: the second link only works once your fork exists.
submit.blocked: Fix the problems listed above before submitting.

issues.id_invalid: `{id}` is not a valid plugin id. Use lowercase letters, digits and underscores, start with a letter, and keep it within 64 characters.
issues.id_exists: A plugin with the id `{id}` is already in the catalogue.
issues.id_mismatch: The id does not match mcdreforged.plugin.json, which declares `{expected}`.
issues.id_too_short: `{id}` is shorter than 3 characters, which the catalogue discourages.
issues.id_similar: `{existing}` is very similar to this plugin id (distance {distance}).
issues.related_path_invalid: `{path}` is not a valid directory path inside the repository.
issues.branch_not_found: The branch `{branch}` does not exist in this repository.
issues.plugin_json_missing: `{path}` was not found in this branch.
issues.plugin_json_unreadable: `{path}` could not be parsed as JSON.
issues.introduction_missing: Provide an introduction for at least one language.
issues.introduction_path_not_found: The {language} introduction file `{path}` does not exist in this branch.
issues.labels_missing: No label selected. Labels describe what your plugin does.
issues.authors_invalid: Author number {indexes} has an empty name.
issues.authors_missing: No author declared. A link is optional, but a GitHub link helps maintainers verify ownership.
issues.no_license: No open source license was detected at the repository root. We recommend adding one to protect your work.
issues.no_release: No release with a tag matching the plugin version and a .mcdr/.pyz asset was found. The catalogue can only show released plugins.

home.description: A rewritten version of MCDaemon, a Python tool to control your Minecraft server
home.description_alt: This is a python based Minecraft server control tool

feature.vanilla: It's running above the server. It doesn't need to modify the server at all, which keeps everything vanilla
feature.plugins: From an in-game calculator, player highlighter, and Twitch chat bot, to a scoreboard manipulator, file manager, and backup system, all of them can be implemented with MCDReforged plugins
feature.compatibility: Supports running various types of servers, including but not limited to vanilla, fabric, paper, and bungeecord, on Linux / Windows

update_report.note: These messages come from the plugin catalogue update check. They are intended for plugin authors and maintainers diagnosing metadata, release package, or repository sync problems. They do not mean the plugin cannot be installed or used; regular users can safely ignore this page.
